name: @stufen/core-auth
provides: createAuth (AuthPort on any AuthStore, plus createDevSession, which is refused in production)
createInMemoryAuth (createAuth with the in memory store, for development and tests)
createPostgresAuthStore (AuthStore on PostgreSQL through db as owner, tokens stored as SHA-256 hashes, plus deleteExpiredSessions and deleteExpiredLinkTokens)
types AuthPort and AuthSession, re exported from contracts
